title: Google Cloud gives Gemini agents their own Workspace accounts and directory seats
summary: Google's new Gemini coworker agent gets a per-instance Workspace account with its own email, calendar and Drive, so colleagues can delegate to it like a teammate (private preview).
reason: Agents treated as organisational members; enterprise preview.

title: Pentagon Tradewinds lets AI vendors win contracts via five-minute videos
summary: The Pentagon's CDAO lets AI vendors pitch in five-minute videos and can award contracts, including for kill-chain tools, in under a week without competitive bidding.

title: Anthropic usage policy bans sustained abuse of Claude from Nov 12
summary: Anthropic's updated usage policy bars sustained, needless cruelty toward Claude, without claiming it can suffer, and adds rules against election deception.
reason: Model-welfare protection in a binding usage policy; small step toward AI moral consideration.
